tools.name: identify_client
tools.description: Who a User-Agent and/or an MCP clientInfo.name claims to be, matched against criba's catalog of known MCP indexers, verifiers, A2A directories, AI crawlers, scanners and HTTP libraries. This is a declaration, not proof: use classify_visitor for behaviour. Pass at least one of the two.

tools.name: classify_visitor
tools.description: Classify one visitor from its requests to your MCP server, A2A agent or website. Returns the declared identity, the observed behaviour class (acts-on-results, agent-tool-use, agent-message, probe, indexer, web-scanner, web), the signals and reasons, and mismatch=true when behaviour contradicts the d

tools.name: list_known_bots
tools.description: List criba's catalog of known agent-ecosystem bots, optionally filtered by category or protocol. Each entry has its id, name, category, URL, matching rules and what it was seen doing. Catalog 2026-11-08, CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial use with attribution).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_known_bots · Public sink: classify_visitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_known_bots · Public sink: classify_visitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
